overview: The original building drawings show studios and one- and two-bedroom layouts around four lifts, with shared rooftop recreation.
research.locationNote: DLRC, Dubailand, near Academic City and Dubai Silicon Oasis. Future transport proximity and fixed journey times are not confirmed.
research.priceNote: No live developer price published. Property Finder shows AED 665,000 in its headline and AED 610,000 in its narrative, alongside a sold-out label; these do not confirm stock.
research.paymentNote: Developer reference plan: 20% booking, 30% construction and 50% completion. Original December 2024 booking dates are historical; request current terms.
research.handoverNote: Imtiaz expects November 2026; Property Finder retains December 2026. Both are Q4 forecasts, with certified handover unconfirmed.

facts.label: Broker-reported original mix
facts.value: 169 studios, 78 one-bedroom and 13 two-bedroom homes; 260 total. Original factsheet not independently retrieved.

facts.label: Post-handover reference
facts.value: Developer FAQ: 20% booking, staged payments, 15% completion and 30% over three years at 2.5% quarterly.

facts.label: Website progress snapshot
facts.value: 45% overall when checked; no inspection date stated. This does not establish completion.
